messages:
Implement JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) resolution

Add resolvePointer, which walks a JSON document per RFC 6901 token
unescaping and indexing rules, throwing on malformed pointers or
pointers that don't resolve to a value. Tests cover the RFC's own
worked examples plus error cases.
